secrets.description: Aliases (`${secret:ALIAS}`) and the references they resolve to.

account.description:
The 1Password account Loadout's `op` calls use (sign-in address,
shorthand or account id), for machines whose desktop app is signed
in to several accounts (gate V1 FB-7). A service account token
names its own account.

environment.description:
Id of the one 1Password Environment holding MCP secrets (an
identifier, not a secret).

SecretEntry.description: One alias. Also the shape of a per-machine override (SPEC 5.6).

env_name.description: Environment variable name used by env delivery (default: the alias).
